d: Two Dan Sullivans, one Alaska Senate election, and a Donald Trump controversy! A bizarre namesake candidate row has triggered allegations of voter confusion, a criminal investigation and fresh questions about America's electoral process. Trump believes a rival candidate sharing the Republican incumbent's name could divert votes. But this unusual election drama has a familiar Indian connection. From Hema Malini's namesakes to Rahul Gandhi lookalikes and dummy candidates, India has witnessed similar electoral tactics for years. Now, as Alaska finds itself caught in a political name game, we…
